stories.title: US proposes new tariffs on 14 trading partners, including China and the EU
stories.line: The US has proposed new tariffs on 14 trading partners, including China, the EU and Brazil, over alleged subsidized production.

stories.title: Army to detonate five tons of unstable lead explosives in Iowa, lead plume expected
stories.line: The Army will detonate about five tons of unstable lead azide in Iowa, sending a possible lead-dust plume over nearby residents.

Nvidia chips still sold in China despite US ban, with prices climbing
stories.line: Chinese resellers still openly sell US-restricted Nvidia AI chips, with Blackwell server prices rising past $3 million.

stories.title: Country musician Ketch Secor urges artists to break silence on assault rifles
stories.line: A country musician is urging fellow artists to speak out on gun violence after the Nashville school shooting, despite fear of fan backlash.

stories.title: Leaked Russian data puts military deaths in Ukraine war near 490,000
stories.line: Leaked Russian records reportedly show nearly 490,000 Russian military deaths in the Ukraine war, with Ukrainian conscription and strikes continuing.

stories.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO under Trump pressure; Trump held Nvidia stock
stories.line: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO after pressure from Trump, who reportedly held millions in Nvidia stock, raising conflict-of-interest questions.

stories.title: Fed's preferred inflation gauge hits 3.8%, pointing to a December rate hike
stories.line: Inflation rose to 3.8% in October, making a Federal Reserve interest rate hike in December likely, which would raise borrowing costs.

stories.title: Houthis claim strikes on Saudi refinery and Riyadh; oil prices rise
stories.line: Houthi forces in Yemen reportedly struck a Saudi refinery and claimed attacks on Riyadh, pushing oil prices higher amid a widening regional war.

stories.title: Democrats make southern and downballot gains, then weigh how to use new power
stories.line: Democrats gained ground in the South and downballot races, and now face questions about how to use their new Congressional power.
